entities.name: Pedro José Pidal, 1st Marquis of Pidal
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Pedro José Pidal y Carniado, 1st Marquis of Pidal was a Spanish lawyer, writer, politician and academician who served important political offices in the reign of Isabella II of Spain, including those of Ministry of Governance, Minister of State, Minister of Justice and speaker of the Congress of Deputies.
